title: Dining Plan Fee Card: Surcharges, Tray Delivery and Extras
content:
Fee card of the Dining Plan. The figures below are the same on every plan: the Dining 10, 15, 30, 45 and 60 Meal Plans and the Dining Full Board Plan.

| Item | Figure on every plan |
|---|---|
| Tray delivery to the apartment | 5.50 US dollars per tray |
| Days of tray delivery per illness without the fee, when the wellness nurse orders it | 3 days |
| Sunday brunch surcharge, in addition to the credit or price | 4.00 US dollars per meal |
| Holiday meal surcharge, in addition to the credit or price | 8.50 US dollars per meal |
| Takeout container | 0.50 US dollars per container |
| Nutritional supplement drink | 3.25 US dollars per item |
| Private dining room | 75.00 US dollars per reservation |

## Dining holidays

The holiday meal surcharge applies on these dining holidays, on every plan:

- Easter Sunday
- Mother's Day
- Thanksgiving Day
- Christmas Day
- New Year's Eve

## Notes to the card

1. Both surcharges are added on top of the meal: whether the meal is covered by credits or paid for, the surcharge is in addition to it.
2. The tray figure is per tray delivered; the illness allowance is counted in days of tray delivery per illness, and it depends on the wellness nurse ordering tray service.
3. The private dining room figure is per reservation, not per guest or per meal.

*Hypothetical illustration:* three trays delivered on days that fall outside any nurse-ordered illness allowance come to three times 5.50, 16.50 US dollars; two takeout containers come to 1.00 US dollar.
